approved_decision.rule: Preserve the 20 existing governed safe romanizations unchanged. For the 20 currently unmapped G-IDs, use G-ID as the canonical lossless representation until a separately governed extended-romanization/orthography design assigns human-facing Latin or ASCII forms.
approved_decision.rationale: The language already has complete 40/40 G-ID+IPA authority, while no recovered safe Latin convention exists for the remaining 20. Deferring new tokens avoids arbitrary orthography and protects B1-B4 phonological distinctions.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not change any of the current 20 safe mappings.
Do not assign Y to G16 /j/; Y remains G40 /y/.
Do not invent new digraphs/diacritics merely to reach 40/40 Latin coverage in B5.
Any future extended romanization must pass collision, reversibility, keyboard/input and typography review and remain subordinate to G-ID/IPA authority.
B5 changes no phoneme identities, lexical stress assignments, semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
